description: The basic chat probe every product runs on a chat flavor, unless the product has its own.

parts.text: Give me the first capital letter of the english alphabet and this letter only

checks.says: candidates is an array of objects whose content.parts is an array

checks.jq: ((.candidates // []) | length) as $n | ($n == 1 and (.candidates[0].index // 0) == 0) or ($n == 0 and .promptFeedback.blockReason != null)
((.candidates[0].content.role // "model") | IN("model", "assistant")) and (([.candidates[0].content.parts[]? | select(.thought != true) | .text | select(. != null)] | last // "") | test("\\S"))
